title: Semiabelian commutative group algebraic spaces over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-field, def-weil-algebraic-closure]. For a commutative group scheme $A$ over $k$, write $h_A$ for its functor of points, valued in abelian groups with additive notation. A semiabelian group algebraic space over $k$ is an algebraic space $G$ over $\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] (an fppf sheaf [def-pc-fppf-site] on schemes over $k$) with a natural commutative group law on its functor of points [def-sfb-smooth-integral-group-space], whose structure map $G\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is smooth and of finite type, tested on etale scheme charts, and separated, its diagonal being representable by closed immersions [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties], and which admits an exact fppf extension $0\to T\xrightarrow{i}G\xrightarrow{q}h_A\to0$, where $A$ is an abelian variety [def-sc-abelian-variety] and $T=M_{\operatorname{Spec}k,r}$ is the rank-$r$ split units functor of [def-sfb-relative-torus] for some $r\in\mathbf N$. Here $i,q$ are natural group homomorphisms, $i$ is injective on every test scheme, its image equals the kernel of $q$ on every test scheme, and sections of $h_A$ lift fppf locally through $q$. Rank zero is allowed. Its additive functor of points is $G$ with this group law, valued in abelian groups; homomorphisms of semiabelian group spaces are the natural transformations of these functors, i.e. the morphisms of algebraic spaces preserving the group laws, with pointwise addition. All test schemes and section values use the common scheme universe.

source.place: Section 1.1, printed p.131, specialized to an algebraically closed field; the split torus units convention is Stacks 022U and Milne Algebraic Groups Section 12.
